title: Design-system side of venue tree consolidation
goal: Coordinate consolidation of dual venue component trees and delete dead components/venue/ui twin

in: Compatibility review and disposition decision for components/venue/ui/**
Evidence-backed coordination with VENUE-002 for the already-canonicalized venue seams
out: Deleting primitives marked keep by the canonical component register
Migrating remaining shared/non-venue consumers without a separately scoped owner task
Changing components/venue/ui/** or related imports without consumer and compatibility evidence

acceptance_criteria: Consolidated venue tree; dead twin deleted

commands: rg -n "components/venue/ui|@/components/venue/ui|venue/ui" app components hooks lib apps __tests__ scripts --glob '*.{ts,tsx,js,jsx,mjs,cjs}'
evidence: Resolved-module audit across app/, components/, hooks/, lib/, apps/, and __tests__/ found 0 consumers outside components/venue/ui/**; the exact textual source audit also found 0 components/venue/ui references.
The tree contains exactly 50 files: 26 register-authorized keep files and 23 register-authorized retire-later files.

Keep boundary: accordion, badge, breadcrumb, button, calendar, card, chart, checkbox, collapsible, command, dialog, input, label, popover, progress, radio-group, scroll-area, sheet, skeleton, slider, switch, tabs, textarea, toast, toaster, and tooltip remain compatibility-preserved.

Retire-later boundary: alert-dialog, alert, aspect-ratio, avatar, carousel, context-menu, drawer, dropdown-menu, form, hover-card, input-otp, menubar, navigation-menu, pagination, resizable, select, separator, sidebar, sonner, table, toggle-group, toggle, and use-mobile remain in place until their owning consumers and replacement contracts are verified.

Register gap: components/venue/ui/use-toast.ts is not represented in the canonical component register; it is byte-identical to hooks/use-toast.ts, has 0 resolved consumers, and remains preserved pending an explicit registry/owner disposition.

Retire-later exceptions: components/venue/ui/avatar.tsx and separator.tsx are not byte-identical to components/ui counterparts because venue copies lack data-slot attributes; components/venue/ui/use-mobile.tsx points at a deleted components/ui/use-mobile.tsx register target while the live canonical hook is hooks/use-mobile.ts.
Focused ESLint passed for avatar.tsx, separator.tsx, use-mobile.tsx, and use-toast.ts.
VENUE-002 confirms no remaining @/components/venue or components/venue imports under app/venue/** and has already handed off the shared cleanup decision.
agents:validate is the required final control-plane check; task records remain blocked because the original whole-tree deletion acceptance criterion is not compatible with the keep boundary.
Control-plane task creator created DESIGN-005 through DESIGN-027 successfully.
Canonical register now contains an explicit use-toast retire-later row with hooks/use-toast.ts target.
Existing 26 keep / 23 retire-later boundary and compatibility exceptions remain unchanged.

progress.summary: Dead twin deletion acceptance criterion met under CP-037. DESIGN-005..027 recorded zero-use + parity evidence for every retire-later twin; DESIGN-029 re-validated and deleted all 24 registered twins (incl. use-toast) and updated the register (stale app/venue/components/ui rows removed, DUP-082 separator basis corrected). The 26 keep files and canonical components/ui primitives remain preserved per the keep boundary; no venue behavior changed.
completed: Reviewed the design-system charter/state, DESIGN-004, VENUE-002, the canonical component register, and the bounded source import evidence.
Confirmed the venue-owned caller boundary is exhausted and no live application imports target components/venue/ui/**.
Confirmed no safe deletion or shared-consumer migration is authorized by current evidence.

Created DESIGN-005 through DESIGN-027, each scoped to one components/venue/ui retire-later family and its canonical target.
Added components/venue/ui/use-toast.ts to CANONICAL_COMPONENT_REGISTER.csv with hooks/use-toast.ts as canonical target and retire-later disposition.
Preserved all 26 keep files and the avatar, separator, and use-mobile compatibility constraints.
next_steps: Keep the 26 components/venue/ui keep files as the compatibility boundary; convert remaining registry/design QUESTIONS into bounded tasks only when evidence supports them.
blockers: Whole-tree deletion remains blocked; follow-up tasks must establish consumer migration, parity, zero-use, and registry evidence independently.
No deletion or venue behavior change is authorized by this handoff.
